command.name: security key-manager health policy show
command.description: This command displays the health monitor policies

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the health monitor policies with the given keystore-type value.

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the health monitor policies with the given enabled value.

parameter.name: manage-volume-offline
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the health monitor policies with the given manage-volume-offline value.

example.p: The following example lists all health monitor policies.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager health policy show Health Monitor Automatically Manage Keystore Type Enabled? Volume Offline? ------------- -------------- -------------------- OKM true false KMIP true false AKV true true GCP true false AWS true false IKP true true 6 entries were displayed.
